title: Laws for Peace Offerings

questions.question: What rule applied to eating the guilt offering?
options: Only the priest who offers it shall eat it
It was shared with the poor
questions.correctAnswer: Only the priest who offers it shall eat it
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:6 (ESV): "Every male among the priests may eat of it... it is most holy."

questions.question: Which parts of the peace offering belonged to the priest?
options: The breast and the right thigh
questions.correctAnswer: The breast and the right thigh
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:34 (ESV): "For I have taken the breast... and the right thigh... and have given them to Aaron the priest."

questions.question: If the peace offering was for thanksgiving, when must it be eaten?
options: On the day of the offering
questions.correctAnswer: On the day of the offering
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:15 (ESV): "The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering."

questions.question: What happened if someone ate the flesh of the peace offering while unclean?
options: That person shall be cut off from his people
questions.correctAnswer: That person shall be cut off from his people
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:20 (ESV): "But the person who eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of the Lord's peace offerings while an uncleanness is on him, that person shall be cut off from his people."

questions.question: Who was forbidden from eating fat or blood?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:26 (ESV): "Moreover, you shall eat no blood whatever, whether of fowl or of animal, in any of your dwelling places."

questions.question: If the peace offering was a vow or freewill offering, how long could it be eaten?
options: Two days (remainder burned on the third)
questions.correctAnswer: Two days (remainder burned on the third)
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:16 (ESV): "But if the sacrifice... is a vow... it shall be eaten on the day... and on the next day what remains of it may be eaten."

questions.question: What happened to meat left over on the third day?
options: It was an abomination and must be burned with fire
questions.correctAnswer: It was an abomination and must be burned with fire
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:17-18 (ESV): "What remains of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire... it shall not be accepted."

questions.question: What type of bread accompanied the thanksgiving sacrifice?
options: Unleavened loaves mixed with oil, wafers, and loaves of leavened bread
questions.correctAnswer: Unleavened loaves mixed with oil, wafers, and loaves of leavened bread
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:12-13 (ESV): "He shall offer with the thanksgiving sacrifice... With the sacrifice... lie shall bring his offering with loaves of leavened bread."

questions.question: What was done with the skin of the burnt offering?
options: Given to the priest who offered it
questions.correctAnswer: Given to the priest who offered it
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:8 (ESV): "The priest who offers any man's burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering that he has offered."

questions.question: What specific fat forbidden to eat was mentioned?
options: Fat of ox, sheep, or goat
questions.correctAnswer: Fat of ox, sheep, or goat
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:23 (ESV): "You shall eat no fat, of ox or sheep or goat."

questions.question: What ritual was performed with the breast of the offering?
options: It was waved as a wave offering before the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: It was waved as a wave offering before the Lord
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:30 (ESV): "The breast may be waved for a wave offering before the Lord."

questions.question: What ritual was performed with the right thigh?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:32 (ESV): "And the right thigh you shall give to the priest as a contribution from the sacrifice of your peace offerings."

questions.question: Where were the guilt offering and sin offering killed?
options: In the place where they kill the burnt offering
questions.correctAnswer: In the place where they kill the burnt offering
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:2 (ESV): "In the place where they kill the burnt offering they shall kill the guilt offering."

questions.question: What was the penalty for eating fat of an animal from which an offering was made?
options: Being cut off from his people
questions.correctAnswer: Being cut off from his people
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:25 (ESV): "For whoever eats the fat of the animal of which an offering by fire is made to the Lord shall be cut off from his people."

questions.question: What portion of the freewill offering belonged to the Lord?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:33 implicates the fat portions are burned to the Lord as per typical peace offering rules (Lev 3:16).

key_verse_text: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the grain offering, of the sin offering, of the guilt offering, of the ordination offering, and of the peace offering...
